results.content: Multi-Objective Optimization of a Three-Level Sustainable Food Supply Chain: Modeling the Impact of Government Subsidies | Global Journal of Flexible Systems Management. The first objective function minimizes the total cost of the supply chain, the second objective function minimizes the emission of pollutants in the production as well as distribution sectors of the supply chain, and the third objective function minimizes the ratio of products produced through the green process to total products produced, such that it considers operations constraints of the problem. The sensitivity analysis of the \({\uplambda }_{pk}\), a key determinant in supply chain management which models the subsidy level for green production processes, as outlined in Table6, represents the subsidies for producing products using different production processes. This study presented a comprehensive multiple objective optimization model for a three-tier food supply chain which unifies cost efficiency, emission control, and proportion of green output under government subsidy schemes. results.title: E-commerce and logistics sprawl: A spatial exploration of ...
results.content: # *E*-commerce and logistics sprawl: A spatial exploration of last-mile logistics platforms. Do e-commerce logistics platforms open closer to urban consumers to meet heightened time-demands and do they decentralize in alignment with broader warehousing trends? Platforms serving last-mile deliveries locate closer to consumers than upstream platforms, but facility size, costs, public incentives received, and metropolitan population, among other factors, determine centrality. Platforms opened between 2020 and 2021, including last-mile platforms, located less centrally than years prior with implications for facility operations. This study spatially and statistically explores the facility- and region-level dimensions that characterize the centrality of e-commerce logistics platforms. Results reveal that although some platforms serving last-mile deliveries locate closer to consumers than upstream distribution platforms to better fulfill time-demands, centrality varies due to facility operating characteristics, market size, and when the platform opened. ## Data availability. The data that has been used is confidential.
